compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is for a "Shopping list" application. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **Title Bar**: At the top, there is an orange title bar with the text "Shopping list" indicating the purpose of the screen.
2. **Back Button**: On the left side of the title bar, there is a back arrow icon to navigate to the previous screen.
3. **Share Button**: On the right side of the title bar, there is a share icon, allowing the user to share the shopping list with others.
4. **Empty List Area**: The main area of the screen is currently empty, indicating that no items have been added to the shopping list yet.
5. **Add Button**: At the bottom right corner, there is a green circular button with a plus (+) icon, which is used to add new items to the shopping list.

The status bar at the top shows the time and various status icons for notifications
